subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers accept the route-accurate proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93620 and refresh it as the canonical fix for this MiniMax M3 replay regression, or require live OpenRouter/MiniMax proof first?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear and the linked PR has focused proof, but the PR is currently conflicting and no live hosted MiniMax/OpenRouter current-main proof was run in this review.

options.title: Refresh And Review Linked PR
options.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the sanitizer and transcript-policy coverage focused, and let maintainers decide whether the route-accurate proof is enough to merge.

options.title: Require Live Provider Proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR paused until someone with credentials adds redacted live OpenRouter/MiniMax next-request payload proof for plain-text and tool-call replay.

options.title: Replace The Candidate PR
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting PR only if a new narrow branch lands the same replay fix with stronger proof.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Review Linked PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the sanitizer and transcript-policy coverage focused, and let maintainers decide whether the route-accurate proof is enough to merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent area history and already gave maintainer review direction on the linked candidate PR.
